selection: Round-robin genre/source/upstream/length strata, deterministic SHA-256 order; one per canonical component before additional members. All component members embargoed. Document-group role consumes at most 400 full-component documents per style; unused members of selected groups remain embargoed. Large-family coverage is limited by this budget.

role_definition.document_groups: New recorded document/group identities outside withheld source units; previously inspected v4/v6 groups excluded.
role_definition.source_shift: Source units withheld from the FUTURE v7 training and validation; some sites were used by historical v4/v6 models. Not a universal unseen-publisher test.

limitations: Candidate labels are source-provisional/AI-assisted, never independent human gold. Exact future model views need semantic review before reference freeze.
Source-shift units are portal, journal site or upstream platform strata, not five independent publishers. Adilet and Zan are related legal portals; all scientific journal sites are KazNU.
Several source units were used by historical models. The embargo is prospective for v7; legacy metrics and historical prediction restoration are unchanged.
Known v4/v6 identity, hash, provenance and canonical-group matches are excluded from candidate evaluation. Other past diagnostic texts require an additional exact-view overlap audit.
Unknown cross-site author aliases, review product/author IDs and encoder pretraining overlap remain unresolved.
This deliberately diverse sample does not estimate corpus-wide class prevalence. Reserve selection does not certify correctness of the full corpus.
The 400-document per-style group-embargo budget limits representation of large author/passage families. Candidate counts are fixed, group counts may differ.
supersession_reason: Preflight builds not used by any training. Final version distinguishes registry/archive transport URLs from individual document URLs and verifies that the guard blocks exactly the canonical reservation closure.
